title: docs(skills): objectstack-api teaches the recycle bin a by-id delete keeps, not a hard delete
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xMd2uojmQxPgwLMrBLkrFXY)_

Refs #30847

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03) waives the contract-review model tier that `dispatch-gates` mandates for `skills/**` (clause ①); this PR was developed below that tier, and the dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` 三处：L48 路由表 `DELETE` 注释由 "hard delete" 改为 "business-object rows → recycle bin"；派生动词说明 `restore` / `purge` 不派生的理由由"trash 面已退役"改为"回收站还没有 restore / purge 入口"；陷阱第 2 条改写为：按 id 删除业务对象会把行保留在 `sys_recycle_bin`（默认 30 天），`multi: true` 删除、平台行、回收站上线前删除的行不在其中，目前没有任何 API 能列出或恢复它（`sys_recycle_bin` 为 `apiEnabled: false`），不要自造软删除。评测 `evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json` 第 5 例的期望同步改为回收站的说法。另加一条 changeset。
- 为什么改：PR #30780（ADR-0148）合入后，按 id 删除会把行快照进回收站，技能却仍教"硬删除、没有回收站"，读技能的 agent 会自造软删除，或告诉用户删除的记录无法找回。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文本，运行时零改动；三段各自行数不变，文件 441 → 441 行，token 5141 → 5157（上限 6314 不动，不付账）；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：SKILL.md L48、L268-270、L417-420；评测第 5 例。
- 范围：本 PR 只做 triage 审计要的"立即纠正"部分，所以写 `Refs` 不写 `Fixes`；restore / purge 入口、权限与 REST 路由的教学等 #30237 的 restore 与 REST 入口 PR 落地后再补。
- 需要你做的：Tier H（`skills/**`），需要受管审批人在 GitHub 上 Approve 一次；之后席位落地。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`, three passages, each at its original line count:

| Where | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| L48, data route block | `DELETE … # Delete record (hard delete)` | `DELETE … # Delete record (business-object rows → recycle bin)` |
| L268-270, derived verbs | "`restore` / `purge` never derive — the trash surface is retired." | "`restore` / `purge` never derive: the recycle bin has no restore or purge door yet." (re-flowed inside its own three lines) |
| L417-420, pitfall 2 | "ObjectStack `DELETE` is a hard delete — there is no recycle bin. For recoverability, use per-field `trackHistory` … or a `lifecycle` archive policy instead of custom soft-delete logic." | "**Treating `DELETE` as final or as restorable.** A by-id delete keeps a business object's rows in the recycle bin (`sys_recycle_bin`, 30 days by default; not `multi: true` deletes, platform rows or rows deleted before the bin existed); nothing lists or restores it over the API yet. No soft-delete." |

`skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json`, case 5 only (claim surface widened by the seat in rework round 1): `expected_output` no longer says `restore` / `purge` never derive "because DELETE is a hard delete; recoverability is per-field `trackHistory` or a `lifecycle` archive policy". It now says they never derive, a by-id delete of a business object already keeps its rows in the recycle bin (`sys_recycle_bin`), but nothing lists or restores them over the API yet, so there is no restore operation to add and no custom soft-delete to build. `must_contain` swaps `trackHistory` / `lifecycle` for `sys_recycle_bin` / `recycle bin`; `must_not_contain` keeps `'restore'`.

`.changeset/api-skill-delete-recycle-bin.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, both declaration lines. No `skip-changeset` label: a `skills/**` diff ships in `@objectstack/skills`.

Each claim, read off `main`:

- **A by-id delete keeps the rows.** `packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/capture.ts` (PR #30780): `ObjectQL.delete`'s by-id branch (`runByIdDelete`, `engine.ts` ≈L9514) snapshots the cascade set and writes one `sys_recycle_bin` entry before the root row is removed. The REST `DELETE /data/{object}/:id` reaches that branch (a scalar `where.id`).
- **Which deletes are not in it.** The same docblock, "Which deletes enter the bin (v1)": not a predicate delete (`multi: true`), not a platform object (`sys_`, `cloud_`, `ai_`, `hasPlatformObjectPrefix`), and a platform row the cascade reaches is left out of the snapshot. Rows deleted before PR #30780 have no entry.
- **30 days by default.** `packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/retention.ts`: host resolver, else `OS_RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS`, else `RECYCLE_BIN_DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS` (30), stamped as `purge_after`; `sys-recycle-bin.object.ts` reaps on that deadline (`ttl`).
- **Nothing lists or restores the bin over the API.** `sys-recycle-bin.object.ts` declares `apiEnabled: false`, `apiMethods: []`, so no generic data route reaches the bin. `allowRestoreOwnDeleted` / `manageRecycleBin` in `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` are `[PLANNED] … Not read yet`; `API_METHOD_DERIVATION` keeps `restore` / `purge` at `flag: () => false`; no engine restore or REST route exists. So the skill names neither permission nor any door (#30237 is still open).
- `restore` / `purge` still never derive and are still stripped from `apiMethods` with a FROM → TO warning (`LEGACY_API_METHOD_GUIDANCE`, `object.zod.ts`), so that half of the L267 sentence stands.

Dropped from the pitfall: the `enable.trash` history (PR #30844 had already cut it) and the pointer to `trackHistory` / `lifecycle` archive as the recoverability answer, which #30847 names as part of the wrong teaching.

**Budget.** `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`: 441 → 441 lines, 20542 → 20646 bytes, 5141 → 5157 tokens (ceiling 6314, headroom 1157). The eval fixture keeps its line count (case 5's two lines change in place; measured, not ratcheted: 1498 → 1529 tokens). Net added lines in `skills/**`: 0. No ceiling row moves, so no deletion payment is owed.

**Serial.** PR #30844 (seat 2) edited the same pitfall. `origin/main` at `000a4c0d` (with #30844) was merged into the branch, no rebase; the one conflict, pitfall 2, takes this PR's rewrite. Rework round 1 merged `origin/main` `c77dd17f` (clean) before its commit.

## Why

#30847 (p2): since PR #30780 the skill contradicts shipped behaviour. An agent following it builds its own soft-delete, or tells a user a deleted record is gone when its snapshot sits in the bin. Triage audit 6679098621 asks for the "no recycle bin" correction now and the restore-door teaching once #30237's restore and REST-door PRs land; this PR is the first half, hence `Refs`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run (no source file in the diff).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
